_doc: Shared model/token budget policy for dashboard Chat, Hermes profiles, and future agent swarms. Free-first. Hermes/think paid only under C8: (1) full free pool exhausted OR (2) verified free failure (explicit success metric + N harness verify-fails). Do NOT re-add tencent/hy3:free (OpenRouter sunset 2026-07-21). Pixi ALLOW_PAID_FALLBACK is a separate key.

providers._doc: Selectable inference providers. Default (unprefixed model id) = openrouter. Route via ZenMux with a `zenmux:<slug>` model-id prefix (dashboard maps it to `hermes --provider zenmux -m <slug>`; Hermes reads providers.zenmux from each profile config.yaml). Adding zenmux does not change default chains.

zenmux.note: OpenAI-compatible; OpenRouter-style slugs. Set ZENMUX_API_KEY in ~/.hermes/.env to enable. Use with the zenmux: prefix, e.g. zenmux:z-ai/glm-4.7-flash-free. ZenMux free variants use a -free slug suffix (NOT OpenRouter's :free). CANNOT be a Hermes profile PRIMARY — Hermes resolves it as provider 'custom' and drops ZENMUX_API_KEY -> 403; dashboard/manual selection only. daily_usd_target is a SOFT policy cap ($5/day) — override with ZENMUX_DAILY_USD in ~/.hermes/.env; not a hard provider-side cap (set that in the ZenMux console).

known_models._source: Verified live against ZenMux /v1/models 2026-07-24 (145 models). Supersedes the 2026-07-18 picker screenshot, which recorded a slug that does not exist.

_invalid.moonshotai/kimi-k3-free: 404 invalid_model — never existed. The real moonshotai/kimi-k3 is PAID at $3/M prompt, $15/M completion (most expensive model in this stack) — do not front chains with it.

cursor.note: Paid Cursor CLI lane on potato — Hub Chat explicit pick cursor:auto only. NOT on think/fast crons. Loads .cursor/skills + rules. Auth: CURSOR_API_KEY in ~/.cursor-agent.env or agent login. Invoke: agent -p --force --disable-auto-update.

ops.note: Dashboard Chat + think/code/meta. Raise live key via OpenRouter UI or set-openrouter-key-limit.sh + MANAGEMENT key.

free.note: Platform hard caps still apply (20 RPM; 50 or 1000 RPD). :free models can 429 at $0.

routing.paid_when_note: Hermes think C8: free_pool_exhausted = THINK_PAID_ON_FREE_EXHAUSTED after full swap 429+reprobe; verified_free_failure = THINK_PAID_ON_VERIFIED_FREE_FAIL after THINK_PAID_FREE_FAIL_N concrete verify fails. Hub Chat may still fall through on 429/refusal via its own free-first chain — not the same gate.
routing._free_models_note: Wide free pool (think-free-swap.json). Never re-add hy3 / kimi-k3-free phantom / qwen next :free. Re-probe: .staging/model-probe/probe_free_models.py.
